parent_metadata_snapshot.note: All 42 TESS and 42 ZTF metadata responses were saved before the R1 serializer failed on unrequested IRSA input-echo columns. No target pixels were opened by T2A.

frozen_manifest.selection_rule: For each source, among consecutive same-field/same-CCD/same-quadrant/same-filter/same-exptime ZTF triples with both adjacent gaps in [30,900] s, select the triple minimizing |delta_pre-232.5827| + |delta_post-432.2595|. Ties are broken by B obsdate, B filefracday, field, ccdid, qid. Selection uses metadata only.

metadata_quality_gate.rule: A, B and C must each have imgtypecode=o and INFOBITS < 33554432. A trial failing this gate is BLOCKED_METADATA_QUALITY and is never replaced by another triple.
metadata_quality_gate.official_threshold_origin: ZTF single-exposure archive guidance: INFOBITS < 33554432 excludes the general bad/unusable epoch bit.

pixel_access_contract.reason_for_candidate_only_products: Preserve independent subtraction evidence until an isolated B candidate actually exists.
pixel_access_contract.coordinate_binding: All products are evaluated at the frozen RA/Dec in the manifest using FITS WCS; no coordinate retuning after pixel access.
pixel_access_contract.mask_rule: Any non-zero ZTF mask value within the frozen target aperture blocks candidate elevation; no post-read mask-bit cherry-picking.
pixel_access_contract.sensitivity_rule: An epoch with no measured target source counts as qualified absence only if the unchanged fixed-coordinate detector recovers preregistered local injections at SNR 8 and SNR 12.

primary_endpoint.name: ISOLATED_B_EVENT
primary_endpoint.definition: A is sensitivity-qualified absent; B has a fixed-coordinate point-source candidate with a clean target mask; C is sensitivity-qualified absent.
primary_endpoint.l0: science-image isolated B event under frozen sensitivity and mask gates
primary_endpoint.l1: L0 plus a spatially consistent PSF-like B signal in the ZTF difference-image product

statistics_contract.rule: Do not treat all 41 source trials as independent Bernoulli draws. Report source-level counts and unique-B-exposure-cluster counts separately.

candidate_adjudication_if_needed: same-exposure mask inspection under frozen nonzero-mask veto
independent-instrument or independent-epoch replication when available
append_only_rule: Negative, blocked, unresolved and positive results are preserved. No B time, source coordinate, timing offset, quality threshold or detector threshold may be replaced after target-pixel access.
